verdict.rationale: OpenAI's docs describe a cloud agent that runs tasks in isolated environments, produces diffs/summaries, and opens PRs for review—matching the build/test/demo-for-review workflow (codex-docs-1,5,6). But community hands-on reports are split: some call it 'shockingly good' and comparable to a junior engineer (codex-comm-18), while others report it 'struggles with almost anything,' lacks real agentic competence versus competitors, and hits tight usage limits that interrupt end-to-end workflows (codex-comm-3, codex-comm-13, codex-comm-8).
